leo.mktg: quick ask for tomorrows launch post 	6 we need a 200-sample micro-rerun (gen-only) with cold + warm KV. deliverables: quantized vs fp16 p50/p95, avg tokens, and 3 length-bucket p95s (0-128,129-512,513-1024). also 5 redacted outputs for legal. deadline EOD.

anya.runtime: can do. which manifest and batching mode? prefer production continuous batching?

leo.mktg: manifest = "social_launch_trim_v2" at s3://rdw-marketing/samples/social_launch_trim_v2/manifest.json. batching = prod continuous. priority HIGH.

sam.dataops: uploaded, note 3 items flagged as long (>880) to exercise truncation. theyre marked "long": true in the manifest.

anya.runtime: queuing on staging-dedicated, will collect traces and redacted samples. run flags: --model redwood-v2-3b --precision fp16,quantized --warmup 25 --max_seq 1024 --seed 20260402 --redact true --collect_traces --bucket_percentiles.

benchbot: queued run r-1825000000-01 on staging-dedicated-7

leo.mktg: please attach a tiny replay bundle suitable for webinar demo and a one-line README with reproduce command.

anya.runtime: run started r-1825000000-01. est 18m.

benchbot: run r-1825000000-01 completed. artifacts uploaded: s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1825000000-01/summary_bucketed.csv, s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1825000000-01/samples_redacted.jsonl, s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-1825000000-01/replay.tar.gz

anya.runtime: quick pulls: quantized p50 90ms p95 418ms avg_tokens 272; fp16 p50 78ms p95 376ms avg_tokens 274. bucketed p95s included; long bucket inflated by 3 truncated items.

sam.dataops: truncated samples flagged "truncated": true in samples_redacted.jsonl. redaction pipeline removed emails/phones.

leo.mktg: perfect. draft slide: "p95 under 420ms on production-like social traffic (quantized)." will add parenthetical about 3 truncated edge cases and link artifacts. tagging @legal for signoff.

legal.bot: received redacted examples and running automated checks. will confirm shortly.

anya.runtime: reproducibility: ./run_bench --manifest manifest.json --run-id r-1825000000-01 --download-artifacts --bucket-percentiles

leo.mktg: thanks all  will wait for legal and then add artifacts to webinar assets and open PR.
